scope: compile-only SM86, D256 Hq24 Hkv4 K8/V8, PagedKVBatchMetadata<false>

tails.compiled_candidate_metadata: unmasked only; partial final row-block tails are in scope

arithmetic.final_quad_reduce_and_reciprocal: native source retained on side 1, bits transported
arithmetic.domain: finite computed QK scores and masked -inf, finite quant scales, positive finite attention scale

main_priority: One actual paired-warp OFF/ON compile; reject resource failure before any host harness or GPU work.

ownership_design.CTA: 512 threads, 16 warps, eight adjacent pairs; each pair retains the native 16 query rows.
ownership_design.QK: side 0 owns keys 0..31 and side 1 keys 32..63 in each 64-key page; score[4][4]. Each score retains grp 0..3 and kk 0..1 native IMMA/FMA order. Group loop is rolled.
ownership_design.PV: side 0 owns D0..127 and side 1 D128..255; acc[8][2][4] contains 64 FP32 scalars. Each dimension retains the four original FP16 HMMA steps over keys 0..63 and the native FP32 promotion/FMA.
ownership_design.Q_scale: Each warp prepares eight original query rows with unchanged H256/quantization. Temporary scales occupy the dead first K stage. After two CTA barriers, each lane retains only its two row scales for group=lid; each rolled QK group uses two quad shuffles.
ownership_design.online_softmax: Each side publishes its two quad-reduced maxima; both obtain the common maximum and identical running_m/alpha. Only max grouping changes; finite/signed-zero lowering must be checked in PTX/SASS.
ownership_design.denominator: side 0 computes native serial bl for nt 0..3 and publishes two FP32 carries per lane. side 1 continues nt 4..7 without regrouping and alone executes native running_l FMA. Final native quad sum and reciprocal execute on side 1; lid 0 publishes inv_l for both D128 owners.
ownership_design.P_alias: Current K bytes are reused only after all QK consumers pass barrier A. Each pair owns 2048 bytes. Each half owns two [32 lanes][uint4] fragments, j-major; carry temporarily aliases the first 256 bytes of high P. Side 1 completes carry reads before warp sync and high-P writes.
ownership_design.tile_shift: side 0 retains the full V-tile maximum and exact power-of-two shift; shift lives in dead current K-scale bytes and side 1 reads the same integer. V scales are streamed per PV j, shrinking the live scale array from eight to two words.
ownership_design.lifetimes: Per page: cp_wait and entry barrier, prefetch next stage, QK/max then A, low P/carry/shift then B, high P after warp sync then C, both D128 PV consumers. Next entry precedes reuse of this stage for kb+2. Final denominator has a terminal CTA barrier.
ownership_design.shared: Original Q32768 plus two33792-byte KV stages plus1024-byte max/final-denominator scratch =101376. There is no third KV stage.
ownership_design.tails: Both paired warps have identical tile_live and all warps reach every CTA barrier. Partial final row-block rows and inactive pairs are preserved. The prepared instance uses PagedKVBatchMetadata<false>; masked batches and other geometry/codec instances are excluded.

resource_plausibility.qualification: These are source arrays, not compiler registers. Pointer/control state, decode temporaries and scheduling still count. Both roles share one static register allocation on SM86. <=128 registers with zero spills is plausible but unproved.
resource_plausibility.occupancy: Both variants are limited to one CTA by shared memory. A successful 512-thread/<=128-register lowering can expose16 rather than8 resident warps, without claiming 2x throughput.

exact_and_oracle_contract.exact_execution_reference: Pinned native K8/V8 fast prompt instance, same represented inputs, physical block table, positions, launch row order, scale and compiler policy. The candidate must match every observable BF16 output bit; no state/codec/sampling changes.
preserved_boundaries: BF16 query loads and native normalized H256 order
native transient Q scales and signed INT8 quantization
stored FP16 K scales to FP32; ordered group INT32 QK and FP32 products/FMA
native scaled exp2 approximation; FP16 packed P
stored FP16 V scales, same full-tile power-of-two shift and FP16 V decode
four native FP16 PV accumulator steps per64-key page; FP32 promotion and running-accumulator FMA
native FP32 online denominator serial pair-adds/FMA; final quad sum/reciprocal; FP32 normalization and BF16 output
exact_and_oracle_contract.mathematical_oracle: Independently decode stored K codes/scales and their inverse normalized H256 interpretation; decode V as FP32(code)*FP32(stored FP16 scale). Evaluate naive FP64 dot, stable softmax over keys0..position, and FP64 V reduction using represented BF16 Q. Do not reproduce private Q quantization, FP16 PV accumulation, or output BF16 rounding in this oracle.
exact_and_oracle_contract.state: q, K/V codes/scales, positions, metadata/table bytes unchanged; output fully overwritten within width; invalid final CTA rows write nothing beyond width. No global workspace or persistent state is added.
exact_and_oracle_contract.proof_domain: Finite target-representative inputs, finite computed QK scores, finite scale products, positive finite attention scale; masked scores are -inf. NaN/overflow preservation is not established.
exact_and_oracle_contract.executed: Source/DAG, address, half-bit transport and synthetic FP32 model checks only; neither full mathematical oracle nor GPU parity has run.

actual_compile_gate.owner: root, after currently prioritized MMQ work is serialized
actual_compile_gate.compiler: CUDA13.1.115, SM86, -O3, default precise arithmetic; no fast math or register-limit workaround
actual_compile_gate.outputs: OFF and ON objects plus dependency, ptxas, resource, PTX and SASS evidence; no executable/link/host or device launch
reject: any ON stack/local/spill load/spill store bytes or SASS LDL/STL
actual_compile_gate.after_resource_pass: Manual operand/order and synchronization review remains mandatory, including preparation-scale reads before first async copy, shared aliases and partner reciprocal. Resource PASS is not correctness or permission to skip root review.
actual_compile_gate.failure_action: Record failure and stop this candidate; no GPU screen or unchanged syntactic retry.

future_minimal_GPU_gate_not_implemented.prerequisite: Root actual compile gate and manual PTX/SASS review pass before any host harness is prepared.
future_minimal_GPU_gate_not_implemented.correctness: One bounded run: native/candidate BF16 bit parity, independent FP64 criterion, input/cache/table/canary checks. Cases cover widths33/127/129/1280, base0 and width1280/base31488, noncontiguous physical pages, low/high key asymmetry, zero/uniform and realistic finite scaled data, and tile_shift0/>0.
future_minimal_GPU_gate_not_implemented.performance: After correctness, one fixed exploratory screen of the complete page-loop kernel at width1280/base0 and width1280/base31488, with identical data/cache policy, warmup and counterbalanced order. No QK-only timing and no CI claim.
future_minimal_GPU_gate_not_implemented.proposed_cost_filter: Pre-register before execution: at least10% time reduction in the long-depth primary and at most1% regression at the short-depth guard. Otherwise stop before server integration or statistical confirmation.

profile_contribution.interpretation: Diagnostic attribution, not measured critical-path fractions or a matched candidate baseline. Conditional saving assumes the removed kernel time lies on the selected serial request spans.
profile_contribution.conclusion: Long-context prompt is the only plausible payoff. No foreign GPU headline, 2x warp count or lower register count establishes a speedup.

limitations: Actual CUDA compile failed the prespecified resource gate: ON128 registers,120B stack,200/232B spill stores/loads. No numerical or runtime qualification.
No host/GPU harness, exports, reservations, service changes or core integration.
CPU lifetime model is not a compiled race proof; final compiler lowering and runtime qualification remain necessary.
Masked metadata and other geometry/codec routes are outside this prepared instance.
next_gate: Do not build a host harness or run GPU unchanged. Reopen only after a concrete lifetime/schedule change that eliminates stack/local/spills at <=128 registers.
